name: Upscale Suite
intro: Upscale Suite makes a small or soft image larger and sharper with AI. Upload a picture, choose a method, and download the bigger result.

features.upload-and-pexels: Start by getting your image in. Use the picker button to upload, or the Pexels button to browse free stock photos.
features.method-picker: The method picker at the top offers AI Upscaler, Topaz Upscale and Seed Upscale. Each gives a different look, so try more than one on important images.
features.scale-factor: Open the Advanced panel to find Scale Factor for the AI Upscaler. Choose two times to double width and height, or four times for even more.
features.upscale-image: The Upscale Image button starts the job. It reads Upscaling while it works, and it needs an image loaded first.
features.result-card-download-and-publish-to-soci: The result card has Download to save your enlarged image, and Publish to Social to share it right away.
features.thumbnail-tools-menu-and-attachments: Thumbnail lets you make a custom cover for the studio, and the three-dot menu holds Recipes and Prompts as optional extras.

outro: That's Upscale Suite. Begin with your best original, try two times before four times, and save upscaling for the very last step.
